items.name: Reconnection
items.description: Restore service after disconnection due to non-payment, once dues are settled.
items.requirements: Settlement of past dues, Valid government ID, Accomplished application form

items.name: Meter testing
items.description: Request a meter accuracy test if you believe your reading is incorrect.

items.name: Leak reporting
items.description: Report visible leaks in mainlines or service lines for repair scheduling.

items.name: Transfer of ownership
items.description: Update account records when a property or connection changes hands.
items.requirements: Valid government ID, Proof of property/lot right, Accomplished application form

items.name: Change of meter location
items.description: Request relocation of an existing meter within the same property.
items.requirements: Valid government ID, Accomplished application form

items.name: Senior citizen / PWD discount
items.description: Applicable billing discounts per RA 9994 and RA 10754, subject to verification.
items.requirements: Valid government ID, Senior citizen ID or PWD ID
